One of the most important factors, which is sometimes misunderstood, is longevity — that is, how long you might live. This is different from your life expectancy, which is how long an individual of your age, gender, and health would be anticipated, on average, to live.

From Parameters tab
ℹ Starting Portfolio is pre-filled from your projection at Retirement Age and includes all accounts including Inkomstpension. You can override the value manually.

⚠ Note on returns: Expected return μ and volatility σ are computed year by year from the equity allocation brackets. μ = Equity% × Real Equity Return + Bond% × Real Bond Return (from Parameters tab). σ = √(Equity%² × σ_eq² + Bond%² × σ_bd²), assuming zero correlation between equities and bonds (ρ = 0). Bracket defaults are the portfolio-weighted average equity % across your accounts, excluding Inkomstpension. Inflation defaults to 0% since returns are already real.

⚠ Note on Inkomstpension: Inkomstpension is a guaranteed defined-benefit state pension — its future payments do not depend on investment returns. If you include it in your Monte Carlo simulation, you should set Expected Return μ and Volatility σ to bond-like values (e.g. μ ≈ 2–3%, σ ≈ 3–5%) to reflect its low-risk, fixed-income character. Alternatively, exclude it from the portfolio and model only your investable assets.

About the model
Where the calculations come from, and what is developed for this planner
SOURCE AND CREDIT

The pension calculations in this planner are based on Typfallsmodellen v4.8, published by Pensionsmyndigheten (the Swedish Pensions Agency). Pensionsmyndigheten is the source of the pension model. pensionsmyndigheten.se → Typfallsmodellen

Pensionsmyndigheten allows the tool to be spread and modified, as long as the authority is named as the source: "Du får sprida och modifiera verktyget men du ska ange Pensionsmyndigheten som källa."

This planner is a modified, independent work. It is not an official Pensionsmyndigheten product, and Pensionsmyndigheten is not responsible for its content or results.

OTHER SOURCES
  • Skatteverket: tax rules (grundavdrag, jobbskatteavdrag, state tax) in the Income tab
  • SCB: municipal tax rates by municipality
  • Pensionsmyndigheten: divisors (PFS 2024:2) and target retirement age (riktålder) per birth year
  • minpension.se: typical retiree budgets used by the Basic / Average / Extra buttons in the Expenses tab
TAKEN FROM TYPFALLSMODELLEN
  • Occupational pensions: premiums and payout for ITP 1 / ITP 2, SAF-LO, KAP-KL, AKAP-KR and PA16
  • Income pension and premium pension: PGI, pension index, inheritance gains, divisors
  • Garantipension, Inkomstpensionstillägg, tilläggspension (ATP) and PGB
  • Pension income tax: grundavdrag by age, skiktgräns, burial fee and public service fee
  • Default assumptions (1,9 % return before fees, 1,7 % for occupational schemes, 0 % inflation)
  • Replacement rate (kompensationsgrad) and the key data tables (income index, IBB, PBB)
  • The Withdrawal strategy tab is the Uttagsstrategi tab of the Typfallsmodellen web version, built into this file with the model's engine. The tab is an addition of its own, not part of Pensionsmyndigheten's model.
DEVELOPED FOR THIS PLANNER
  • The Dashboard and all charts
  • Expenses and budget, with the saving goal
  • Withdrawal planning and withdrawal rules
  • Portfolio Value tab and Projection table with exports
  • Scenarios and Monte Carlo simulation
  • Income tab (net salary according to Skatteverket's rules)
  • Plan presets, guided walkthrough, Work after retirement and the Swedish / English interface

The planner gives forecasts, not advice. The results can differ from Typfallsmodellen and from the forecast on minpension.se, for example because the premium pension follows the account's own funds and fees, and because some rules are not modelled.

Pension calculations are based on Pensionsmyndigheten's Typfallsmodellen (source: Pensionsmyndigheten). Charts, budget, Scenarios, Monte Carlo and the planner itself are developed independently; this is not an official Pensionsmyndigheten product. pensionsmyndigheten.se · About the model
